texts: I'd love a doha for a young man who sleeps till noon and idles the rest of the day, telling him that the hours of life are not given to be slept away and that work waits for no sluggard.
stop sleeping, start working
doha pls for my lazy brother who does nothing all day lol
O sleeper, the hours of the day slip through thy fingers while thou dreamest; wake and take up thy work.
My cousin has been jobless for two years, not because there are no jobs but because he cannot get up before one in the afternoon, and my aunt cries every evening about it.
The milk of the morning is wasted on the sleeper; the lazy sit with empty hands while the diligent are fed.
milk, lazy sleeper
doha w milk - the lazy guy sleeps in and misses the fresh milk, the early ones get it. thats me every day
Our milkman comes at five, and my lazy brother is never awake to take it, so every day my mother gets it and he complains there is nothing left for breakfast.
Write a doha about a man who sleeps away the whole morning while the fresh milk is taken by the early risers, teaching that laziness loses what diligence gains and the idle are left with nothing.
lazy days wasted

Please write a Kabir-style doha about those who eat and sleep their lives away and never do the real work they were meant to do, so that they reach the end of their days with nothing to show for them.
My father retired after thirty years with no hobby, no friends, no plans, and spends all day on the sofa half asleep, and I am afraid of becoming like him.
They eat, they sleep, they rise again to eat; the days go by like a pilgrim who never set out.
doha on wasting life sleeping and doing nothing, ive been in a rut for a year
doha w a tree and a forehead mark: the lazy guy puts on the mark and sleeps under the tree all day instead of working
The man at our village square wears the forehead mark of devotion but snores under the big tree all afternoon while his fields lie neglected, and the villagers shake their heads.
tree, forehead mark, idle
Write a doha about the idle man who wears the forehead mark of a pious person and sleeps all day under a tree, while his work remains undone, teaching that appearances do not excuse laziness.
He wears the mark upon his brow and sleeps beneath the tree; the work is never done, and the day is lost.
doha w a leaf and a priest: the priest lies lazily on a leaf bed doing nothing while others work. u know the type
Our priest says he's meditating, but I have seen him lying on a mat of leaves in the afternoon sleeping, while his wife carries all the water and does all the work.
leaf, priest, idle
I'd love a doha about a priest who rests lazily on a bed of leaves all day, calling it contemplation, while real work and real prayer go undone, teaching that idleness is no virtue.
The priest lies idle on his bed of leaves; the world goes on working, and the sleeper wakes to a day already gone.
Write a doha for my friend who has big dreams but never gets out of bed to chase them, telling him that dreams without work are nothing and the lazy man's plans never go beyond his sleep.
dreams need work
My nephew wants to be a famous musician but he hasn't practised for a month and just says he is waiting for inspiration, and his mother says inspiration doesn't come to people who stay in bed.
doha for someone who dreams big but never works
The sleeper's dreams are many and rich, and none of them comes true; only the worker's hand turns dream to deed.
doha w a door - lazy guy sees opportunity knocking at the door but is too lazy to get up and open it
door, lazy man
Opportunity knocks upon the door; the sluggard turns over in his sleep and the knocker goes away.
Write a doha about a lazy man who hears a knock on his door and does not rise to open it, so that the chance of a lifetime passes on, teaching that laziness shuts every door.
A recruiter came to my brother's door with a job offer, and he told his wife to say he was out because he didn't want to get dressed, and the offer went to the next flat.
doha w a needle: the lazy tailor wont even pick up the needle so the shirt stays torn, lazy ppl and small tasks
My uncle is too lazy to use a needle, so his shirt has had a torn pocket for two years, and he says it is not worth the trouble, though he complains about it daily.
The needle lies untouched, and the torn is left torn; the lazy hand is rich in excuses and poor in mending.
needle, lazy hands
Give me a doha about a lazy person who cannot be bothered to pick up a needle for the smallest mending, so that little problems grow large, teaching that laziness turns small repairs into great ruin.
The lazy man sits at the water well and sighs, yet will not draw the water; the ocean of the world offers him nothing.

Write a doha about the lazy man who sits idle beside the well and the ocean wishing for water, but will not lower a bucket, teaching that a man who does not work is thirsty even where there is plenty.
doha with a well and the ocean - lazy guy is beside plenty of water but too lazy to draw it
My neighbour lives by the sea with a well in his yard, and in summer he complains he has no water to bathe because he won't walk to fetch it, and his wife says the problem is laziness.
well, ocean, idle thirst
traveller, sand, rest

Write a doha about a traveller who lies down to rest in the sand and falls asleep, and so never reaches the destination, while the one who kept walking arrives, teaching that laziness makes one fall short of the goal.
doha w a traveller sleeping on the sand when he should keep going, thats me and my goals
On our trek my friend kept resting on the sand every ten minutes and finally slept an hour, a lazy traveller, and we reached the camp at midnight because of him.
The traveller lay down upon the sand to rest awhile; the road went on without him, and the evening found him still.
doha on being lazy, i procrastinate and sleep too much, how do i fix
Rouse thyself, O heart; sloth quietly steals the years and leaves a yawn.
A doha, please, for a person who knows he is wasting life in laziness, sleeping late and avoiding every effort, urging him to rise up and do something meaningful with the strength he has been given.
shake off sloth
I realised last night that I have spent six months doing nothing but sleeping and scrolling, and I felt like a stranger who had given up on his own life.
Sleep is sweet to the idle heart, but the work of the world is sweeter to the one who wakes.
My roommate pressed snooze eleven times and missed the interview that could have changed his life, and then spent the day sulking in the room.
snooze, missed chances
doha about oversleeping and missing out, i keep snoozing my alarm
Write me a doha for people who love to sleep late and miss the best part of life, telling them that those who rise early find the world's gifts while the late sleeper finds only leftovers.
The salt of labour is sweat; the lazy man's meal is tasteless, for he never earned its savour.
Write a doha about the man who will not work and so eats his meals without salt, as nothing in life tastes good to one who has not earned it, teaching that effort gives life its flavour.
doha w salt in it - lazy ppl never taste the salt of their own sweat
salt, sweat, idle meals

My brother-in-law lives off his parents and finds all the food bland and life boring, while his father who worked all his life says every plate tastes rich after a day's honest labour, and I see the salt of work.
winnowing fan, idle hands
The fan lies idle in the lazy hand, and the grain stays mixed with husk; so the sluggard's life is never sorted.
My grandmother handed my lazy cousin a winnowing fan to clean the grain, and he sat idly with it on his lap all morning while she did the whole task herself.
Write a doha about a lazy man who is given a winnowing fan but will not lift it, so the husk and the grain stay mixed, teaching that effort is needed to separate the useful from the useless in life.
doha w a winnowing fan - lazy ppl never do the sorting work, so everything stays a mess

Need a doha for a family where one member refuses to contribute and spends the day lying around while others carry the burden, reminding him that eating without earning is a shame that eventually grows heavy.
At home my elder brother eats three meals a day and has not washed a dish or paid a bill in four years, and my father sighs that he is a grown man sleeping on his parents' labour.
idle at others' cost
He who eats the bread of another's sweat while he sleeps will wake to a hunger that no bread can cure.
doha for a freeloader who wont lift a finger
Write a doha about the man who sits at the market all day talking and doing no business, while the working traders earn their bread, teaching that idle talk and idleness bring poverty.
idle at the market
Idle in the market, he trades in nothing; the busy leave with their purses full, the idle with their yawns.
My uncle goes to the market every morning to gossip with friends over tea, never buying or selling a thing, and my aunt works three jobs to run the household.
doha w a market - lazy guy hangs around the market all day and never does any work
rise and work
The morning calls the willing hand; the sluggard's ear is closed and his day is given to dust.
doha pls for waking up early and doing real work, i need a push
My father wakes at four every day, even on holidays, and says the sluggard buys his poverty with every extra hour of sleep.
Please write a doha praising the early riser who gets up eagerly to do his work and warning the sleeper that those who waste the morning in bed waste the rest of life too.

Write a doha about a lazy man who wants to be carried in a palanquin everywhere rather than walk, though he has strong legs, teaching that those who will not use their own strength remain dependent forever.
doha w a palanquin - lazy ppl want to be carried everywhere instead of walking
palanquin, lazy rider
My rich uncle used to ride in a palanquin to the end of the lane even though he was hale and fit, and now he cannot climb ten steps without gasping, and he blames everyone but himself.
The sluggard rides the palanquin, and the bearers sweat; yet his feet forget the earth and his heart forgets the way.
doha: laziness is slowly ruining my life, my grades, my job. i just dont wanna do anything
Sloth is a sweet poison; it numbs the days till the whole life is a sleep.
sloth ruins life
I used to be the best in my class, but after I started skipping work and spending days on the couch, I lost my job and my friends, and the silence is deafening.
Write a doha about the way sloth slowly ruins a person's grades, job, health and friendships without his noticing, until he awakes to find nothing left, and urging him to rise before it is too late.
doha about the lazy mans excuses, he always has a reason to not do it
Write a doha about the lazy person who always finds a clever excuse for not working, too hot, too cold, too early, too late, and in the end the work remains undone and his life is empty.
excuses, excuses
The sluggard has a reason for every season; and so the seasons pass, and the reasons remain.
My colleague has a new reason every day for why the report is not done, the traffic, the headache, the visitors, and now his boss has stopped asking him for anything at all.
Write a doha about the lazy man who sits in the cage of his own idleness while the mountain of work grows before him, teaching that freedom is opened by effort alone.
doha w a cage and a mountain - the lazy man shuts himself in a cage while the work piles up like a mountain
The sluggard builds his cage of ease and sits inside, while the mountain of his unfinished work grows tall.
cage, mountain, sloth
My friend has stayed in his flat for months like a bird in a cage, ignoring a mountain of unpaid bills and emails, and says he will deal with it all when he feels like it.
get up, work
doha: wake up lazy bones, work isnt gonna do itself
For three weeks I have told myself I will clean my flat, and I keep lying on the sofa while the mess grows, and my mother's silent look is worse than any lecture.

Please give me a couplet addressed to the sluggard who lies sleeping and complaining about hard times, saying that fortune goes only to the one who gets up and does the work, and that complaining from bed feeds nobody.
Awake, O drowsy one, for the work will not come to thee; thou must go to the work.
idleness, the enemy
doha on how being idle makes u unhappy and empty
After I quit my job and stopped doing anything with my days, I noticed that I had grown sadder and emptier, and my therapist said that idleness itself was making me miserable.

Please write a doha explaining that the person who has nothing to do soon becomes unhappy and fills his empty hours with trouble, whereas the one who works finds peace and a purpose to carry him forward.
The idle mind is a debtor to every passing hour; at the end it owes more than it can ever pay.
doha for a friend who says hes too tired to do anything but is just lazy
I want a doha that tells the person who cries about fate and hard luck while doing nothing for himself that fortune loves the worker and that crying and waiting have never filled a single belly.
My cousin blames fate and the economy for his unemployment, but he has not sent a single application in nine months, and when I mention it he says he is waiting for the right chance.
stop waiting, work
The lazy wait for fortune; fortune waits for the worker. Who then shall meet?
doha w a furnace and a blind man - the lazy guy is blind to the work as the furnace stays cold and nothing gets made
The blacksmith's lazy apprentice never lit the furnace on time, and a blind man who came for a plough said he could feel from the cold air that nobody had worked there for days.
The furnace stands cold and the blind man feels no warmth; the idle one is blind to his own undone work.
Write a doha about an idle blacksmith who keeps the furnace cold because he is too lazy to work, and a blind man who senses the neglect, teaching that laziness blinds a man to his duty.
furnace, blind man, idle
I'd like a doha for a person who knows what he must do but keeps scrolling videos and watching shows for hours, telling him that the day is slipping away and that idle amusement steals his purpose.
doha on wasting time on my phone all day instead of working
Yesterday I opened my phone at nine in the morning and it was suddenly evening, and I had done not one thing on my list, and again I felt sick about it.
phone, wasted hours
The hours are poured out upon idle shows, and the heart wakes empty at the end.
At the temple the holy man sleeps and the cleric dozes in his own hall, while the world waits for worship done in deeds.
Write a doha about the temple's holy man and the cleric who lazily sleep through the day instead of guiding others, teaching that the pious too are condemned if idle and complacent.
In our locality the temple's holy man and the local cleric are both famous for sleeping through the afternoon prayers, and the villagers joke that they must be competing for the laziest title.
doha w a temple holy man and a cleric, both lazy and asleep while ppl need guidance
temple, cleric, sleeping
doha: the moneylender wont let the lazy borrower off, he takes his land bcz the guy never worked to repay
The lazy one borrows, the moneylender waits; and when the day of reckoning comes, the idle hand has nothing to give.
I'd love a doha about the lazy man who borrows from the moneylender but never works to repay, until all he owns is taken, teaching that idleness leads to debt and loss.
moneylender, idle debtor
My uncle borrowed heavily from a moneylender and then sat idle all day, and now the creditor has seized his land and he is blaming everyone but himself.
Need a doha about the lazy man who left the lock open on his goods and slept in the forest while thieves came, showing that idleness leaves everything unguarded and loses what diligence would keep.
doha w a forest and a lock - lazy guy never locks up his stuff and loses everything
The lock hangs open in the sleeper's hand, and the forest takes its toll; sloth is the plunderer that comes by day.
My uncle camped in the forest, too lazy to bother locking the cases, and by morning his things had been taken, and he said it was not worth the effort to secure them.
forest, lock, careless sleeper
My neighbour's house has a rusty old sword hanging on the wall that he never cleans, and his whole household is the same, rusty from laziness, as they have not done a thing in years.
house, rusted sword
Write a doha about a man whose sword rusts on the wall of his house because he is too lazy to maintain it, teaching that neglect and idleness corrode our abilities as rust corrodes iron.
doha w a sword n a house, the sword rusts when u dont use it, like lazy people
The sword rusts in the idle house, and the idle hand forgets its strength; sloth is the rust of the soul.

Give me a doha about the lazy man who sits at the crossroads while the grindstone of life turns without him, teaching that those who do not work are ground down by the very world they refuse to work in.
He sits at the crossroads with folded hands, and the grindstone of the days grinds him fine.
My brother just stays in the same town doing the same nothing at the crossroads of his life, and the grindstone of bills and expectations is slowly wearing him down.
doha w crossroads and a grindstone: lazy ppl get ground down by life cuz they dont move
crossroads, grindstone, idle
My friend dreamed of crossing the ocean to study abroad, but he was too lazy to build the bridge of paperwork, and now he watches others go while he sleeps in.
The ocean lies before the sleeper and the bridge is never built; he who will not toil will not cross.
doha w an ocean and a bridge - u wanna cross the ocean but are too lazy to build the bridge
Write a doha about a lazy man who longs to cross the ocean to a better life but refuses to work at building a bridge, teaching that goals are reached only by those who do the labour.
ocean, bridge, lazy dreamer
My daughter's teacher said she has talent but spends the class staring out the window, and when I asked her she said, why try when nobody makes me.
talent wasted by laziness
doha for talented ppl who dont use it cuz theyre too lazy

Write a doha about a person who has great gifts and talents but is too lazy to develop them, so that they remain as useless as if they had never been given, teaching that talent without work is wasted.
The gift unused is as a gift withheld; the lazy hand wastes what heaven gave.
The diamond in a lazy hand is only a pebble; it takes labour to cut and polish a gift into brilliance.
diamond, lazy hands
A doha, please, about a lazy man who inherits a diamond but never learns the craft of cutting and selling it, so he dies poor despite his fortune, teaching that wealth without work is wasted.
doha w a diamond - lazy ppl inherit riches but dont work and end up with nothing
My friend inherited his grandfather's jewellery, including a flawless diamond, but never learned how to run the business or invest it, and within five years it was all gone.

Write a doha about a lazy man who lies on the river bank gazing at the stars and dreaming of success while his work lies unfinished, teaching that stargazing without effort is merely a way to waste a life.
He lies beside the river and counts the stars, and his harvest withers in the field; the stars favour the worker.
river, stars, lazy dreaming
My brother spends every evening on the river bank stargazing and dreaming of a big life while his coursework is ignored, and our father says the stars won't write his exams.
doha w a river and stars - lazy ppl dream and stargaze instead of doing the work
sloth steals life

Please write a doha about how laziness steals a person's life moment by moment, so that they wake in old age and find that they have done nothing, and urging the young to work while strength and time remain.
My grandfather told me with tears that he had spent his best years drinking tea and talking about plans, and now, at eighty, he had nothing to show but regret.
doha on how sloth slowly eats ur life
Sloth is a gentle plunderer that takes the years while thou art sleeping.
doha w a fly - even a fly keeps busy all day, yet lazy humans sit and do nothing
fly, busy, lazy human
The fly is never still from dawn to dusk, and yet the sluggard sits; shame to the man outworked by a fly.
My grandmother watched a fly buzzing from room to room all morning and told my lazy uncle to take a lesson from it, as he was still lying down at noon.
Write a doha in which a tiny fly works busily from morning to evening and puts to shame the lazy man who lies idle, teaching that even the humblest creatures are more diligent than a sluggard.
doha for waking up late and feeling guilty
late riser's regret
The sleeper wakes at noon to find the day already spent; regret is the only wage he earns.
I want a doha for someone who always wakes at noon and then spends the rest of the day regretting it, telling him that each day is a gift and a good beginning is half the work done.
I woke up at two in the afternoon again today and my mother had left my food outside my room without a word, and I felt more ashamed than if she had shouted.
The idle man is a field of weeds; no worker's hand has touched him, and nothing grows.
After my husband stopped working, he lost his appetite, his friends and his spirit, and the doctors found nothing wrong, except that a man with nothing to do begins to fade.
Write a doha about how a person without work or purpose gradually fades in body and mind, teaching that activity and labour keep us healthy and alive while idleness slowly wears us out.
idle man withers
doha on how doing nothing makes people sad and sick
doha: lazy ppl always say tomorrow, and yet tomorrow never comes
My roommate wakes up at noon, plays video games, and tells everyone he will start his life tomorrow, and tomorrow has become a joke between us.
The sluggard sings the song of "tomorrow" every morning; and all his days become one long unlived morning.
lazy tomorrows
Write a Kabir doha about the lazy man who says tomorrow, tomorrow, and sleeps on, until his entire life has gone by in postponement, teaching that sloth steals the only day he has.
My uncle owns a boat but is too lazy to cross the water, so he stays on the bank complaining about prices on the far side, and the scales he uses for weighing grain gather dust.
doha w a boat n scales: lazy guy owns a boat but never uses it, scales just collect dust
Write a doha about the lazy man who has a boat he never rows and scales he never uses, and so lives in poverty beside the waters of plenty, teaching that tools without effort give no gain.
The boat lies idle on the shore, the scales lie idle on the shelf; plenty passes by and the sluggard stays poor.
boat, scales, idle tools
house, needle, lazy mending
The roof leaks and the needle lies unused; the sluggard's house falls in on him before he moves a hand.

Could you do a doha about a lazy householder who ignores the small repairs of his house, the torn curtain or the roof patch or the needle, until it falls apart, teaching that sloth costs more than work.
doha w house n needle, lazy ppl let small repairs slide til the whole house collapses
My uncle's house has a leaking roof and a torn curtain he never repaired because he can't be bothered to pick up a needle, and last monsoon the ceiling fell in.
The lazy man's bier is carried by others, as his life was; he leaves nothing of his own behind.
Write a doha about a man who never worked and is carried to the end on a bier by others, as he was carried all his life, teaching that idle life leaves nothing behind but the weight of his bearers.
At my uncle's funeral, where the bier was carried by his working cousins, the whole family said quietly that he had been carried through life too, never lifting a hand.
bier, idle life
doha with a bier - the lazy man never did anything and even at the end others have to carry him
The sluggard is a blind man in a cage he built himself, and the way out is open if he will only rise.
Write a doha about the lazy man who sits blind to his chances in a cage of his own making, ignoring the opportunity before him, teaching that the idle are the ones who remain imprisoned.
doha w a cage and a blind man: lazy guy is blind to chances and stuck in his own cage
My neighbour kept a bird in a cage and a blind dog, and I noticed he was as lazy as they were, never going out, never changing a thing about his life, and happy to stay trapped.
cage, blind man, sloth
house, moneylender, idle fate
Please give me a couplet about a lazy owner who loses his house to the moneylender because he never worked to maintain or pay for it, teaching that sloth can cost a man his very shelter.
The moneylender took over my uncle's house last year after he missed payments for three years because he didn't bother to work, and now the whole family is renting.
The idle man's house is the moneylender's already; he only lives in it on borrowed sleep.
doha w house n moneylender: lazy owner loses his house to the moneylender cuz he didn't work
The tongue is quick to boast and the hand is slow to work; the lazy man talks of deeds he never does.
My cousin brags with his tongue all day about what he will build and achieve but never gets off the couch, and the whole family has stopped believing any of it.
doha w a tongue - lazy ppl talk big but their hands do nothing
loud tongue, idle hand
Write a doha about the lazy man whose tongue works day and night boasting of great plans while his hands lie still, teaching that talk without work is the mark of the sluggard.

Write a doha about a heron who stands still all day in the water pretending to be wise but is only lazy, waiting for food to come to him without effort, teaching that idleness disguised as patience is still laziness.
The heron stands in the shallows, still as a sage; but it is only the sloth that waits for the meal to arrive.
doha w a heron - lazy ppl pretend its patience but its really just sloth
heron, lazy stillness
My uncle calls himself calm and patient, but like a heron he just stands around all day waiting for success to come to him, and I have started to see that it's plain idleness.
I'd love a doha about the cloud too lazy to rain while the fields below wither, and the lazy man who withholds his effort, teaching that those who hold back their work let all around them suffer.
doha w a cloud - lazy cloud doesnt rain, lazy person doesnt work and everyone suffers
The cloud floats idle in the sky, the field below is parched; so does the lazy man withhold his part.
idle cloud, dry field
In our group project one teammate floated about like a cloud contributing nothing, while the rest of us dried up trying to finish, and the teacher gave us all low marks.
paras, lock, lazy hands
doha w the paras and a lock - lazy guy has the paras but its locked away and he cant be bothered to open it
Write a doha about a lazy man who owns the paras but keeps it locked away, too indolent to use it, so that he remains poor beside his treasure, teaching that gifts are of no use to the idle.
The paras lies locked in the idle man's chest; he will not rise to turn the key.
My friend has access to a great mentor, a real paras for his career, but it's all locked away because he can't be bothered to reply to the messages, and he still wonders why nothing happens.
doha w a tongue and a net - lazy tongue gets caught in the net of its own excuses
My friend's tongue is always full of excuses about why he did not do his work, and the net of those lies has finally closed around him, and his boss has let him go.
tongue, net, excuses
The tongue spins a net of excuses, and the sluggard is caught in it at last.
Write a doha about the idle man whose tongue spins excuses to hide his laziness until he is caught in the net of his own lies, teaching that the lazy end up trapped by their own words.
